title: 21 - Con-tacts
description: Prerequisite: Walk in front of the kneeling man. Tips: - Enter and exit [Orchid Palace Mahjong](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942805) to quickly respawn the conman. Reward: - 20,000 Yen - 5,000 XP

title: 26 - The Drunkard
description: Prerequisite: Walk past the man sitting on the ground. Tips: - You can purchase alcohol from the nearby [Poppo, Tenkaichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942789) - The Premium Malt's is a good cheap option. - Scotch whisky can be purchased from [Poppo, Nakamichi Alley](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942790) - The final stage requires medicine; something like Toughness Z from [Don Quijote](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942786) will do the trick. Reward: - 10 Yen - 500 Yen - Alertness Hood - 5,000 XP

title: 08 - Molestation Accusation
description: Prerequisite: Bump into a woman standing outside the stadium. Reward: - 20,000 Yen - 1,000 XP

title: 35 - The Truth about Beauty
description: Prerequisite: Enter the alleyway and agree to follow the woman. Tips: - Be ready to lose some health before the fighting even starts! Reward: - Black Belt - 2,000 XP

title: 18 - Bump and Scam: Revenge
description: Prerequisite: Complete [17 - Bump and Scam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943121) and return some time later to bump into the thugs again. Reward: - 10,000 XP

title: 01 - The Price of an F-cup
description: Prerequisite: Walk along the street. Tips: - Join Mai for a drink, then refuse to actually drink three times. After the fight, tell the barkeep there's 'not a chance' of you letting him off the hook for the password to a secret casino. Reward: - 100,000 Yen - 5,000 XP.

title: 11 - The Price of a Palm-reading
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man on the street corner. Tips: - Refuse the Lifestone three times to avoid being scammed. Reward: - Lifestone (if you purchased it or avoided the scam) - 30,000 Yen (if you avoided the scam) - 1,000 XP

title: 53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles
description: Prerequisite: Pick up the MesuKing card in front of [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942795) Reward: - [015 - Japanese Rhino Beetle](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943658) - [002 - Face Masher](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943659) - [009 - Omni Choke](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943660) - [017 - Body Slam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943661) - 1,000 XP

title: 10 - Dine and Dash
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man and [Akaushimaru, Tenkaichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942770) employee. Tips: - The dasher moves to the northern end of Nakamichi Street - He then runs to Public Park 3 Reward: - Toughness Infinity - 1,000 XP

title: 15 - The Bouncer
description: Prerequisite: Approach the woman wearing a white dress. Reward: - Italian Scarf - 5,000 XP

title: 22 - The Little Match Girl
description: Prerequisite: Approach the woman holding a basket. Tips: - After helping her sell some matches, you'll find Moemi in Public Park 3. Reward: - Staminan X - Celebrity Perfume - 10,000 XP

title: 19 - Bump and Scam: Three Strikes
description: Prerequisite: Complete [18 - Bump and Scam: Revenge](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943487) and return some time later to bump into the thugs again. Reward: - Colorful Parasol - 15,000 XP

title: 31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II
description: Prerequisite: Complete [30 - The Yakuza's Apprentice](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943354) Tips: - Kano's at the north-western end of the Hotel District. Reward: - Password to a secret casino - Tauriner Maximum - 3,000 XP

title: 24 - Prodigal Son
description: Prerequisite: Approach the homeless man. Tips: - The homeless hunters can be found near [Park Boulevard East](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942818) Reward: - Photo of Gen-san - Sacrifice Stone - 2,000 XP

title: 20 - Bump and Scam: Epilogue
description: Prerequisite: Complete [19 - Bump and Scam: Three Strikes](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943656) and return some time later to bump into the thugs one last time. Reward: - 20,000 XP

title: 23 - The Crane Game
description: Prerequisite: Enter [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942795). You may need to have completed [53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943496) first. Tips: - The first prize needed is a small white-and-orange bird with a red hat. - Aim for dead centre; the claw must grab the bird's hat. - The next three prizes are colourful axolotls; one pink, one blue, and one purple. - The final prize is a large yellow cowboy squirrel. - Try to grab it by the head or the tail. Reward: - 10,000 Yen - 30,000 Yen - 50,000 Yen - [Key I3](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943919) - 1,000 XP

title: 34 - Man Scout
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man on the street corner. Tips: - Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows: - "My manly and beautiful physique" - "I don't look back at the past" - "Tachibana" Reward: - 10,000 Yen - Staminan Spark - for three best answers chosen - Gauntlets - for two best answers chosen - Repair Kit - for one best answer chosen - 10,000 XP

title: 28 - Under Suspicion
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man standing by the street. Tips: - The woman you need to speak to is in front of Volcanic Volcano, wearing a long coat. - Tell her that 'You're very sexy'. - Do not peek, or you'll get a reduced reward. Reward: - 80,000 Yen (if you did not peek - 50,000 if you did) - 10,000 XP

title: 27 - Handbag Hunt
description: Prerequisite: Speak to the woman standing on the street opposite the Millennium Tower. Reward: - 10,000 Yen - 15,000 XP

title: 70 - Practice Match with Professor
description: Prerequisite: Complete [53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943496) and speak to the Professor in [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942795) Tips: - You can hunt for insect and skill cards before beginning your MesuKing journey. Reward: - 1,500 XP

title: 71 - First Rival
description: Prerequisite: Complete [70 - Practice Match with Professor](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943713) and ask to play against someone besides the Professor. Tips: - Tomohiro _always_ chooses Rock. Kick his ass with Paper! Reward: - 2,000 XP - [019 - Giant Swing](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943715)

title: 72 - Private Lesson
description: Prerequisite: Complete [71 - First Rival](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943714) and ask to play against a new opponent. Tips: - If an exclamation mark appears on Sachi's rock attack, she'll use it - counter with Paper! Reward: - 4,000 XP - [016 - Finish Time](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943918)

title: 25 - Bowling Battle
description: Prerequisite: Walk past a man standing next to the reception desk of [Mach Bowl](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942803). You'll need to have completed [23 - The Crane Game](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943666), and may also need to have played the bowling minigame a few times. Some reports say the man you need to walk past only appears at night. Tips: - My go-to strike strategy is to choose the Heavy Tank, start on the far left side, and aim as close to the middle as possible. - Put power to maximum, and use 1-3 'nudges' to get the ball as close to the middle pin as possible. - See the screenshot for reference. Reward: - 30,000 Yen - 2,000 XP

title: 32 - The Yakuza's Apprentice III
description: Prerequisite: Complete [31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943657) Tips: - Use the Rush fighting style to land hits! - The fights will be a little easier if you upgrade Rush's basic combo to have more hits. Reward: - 100,000 Yen - Steel Knuckles - 4,000 XP

title: 33 - The Yakuza's Apprentice IV
description: Prerequisite: Complete [32 - The Yakuza's Apprentice III](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943921) Tips: - After he runs off, Kano can be found outside of [Smile Burger](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942775) Reward: - Masterwork Dagger - 5,000 XP

title: 38 - Pick Pocket Pursuit
description: Prerequisite: Walk past the man wearing a brown coat. Tips: - He's wearing glasses and a grey suit - see the screenshot. Reward: - 70,000 Yen - 1,000 XP

title: 54 - A Goodbye Promise
description: Prerequisite: Fill the A-rank bar with Yui, a hostess at [JeweL](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942799). Reward: - Affection Rank S

title: 55 - Freedom to Romance
description: Prerequisite: Fill the A-rank bar with Rina, a hostess at [SHINE](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942796). Reward: - Affection Rank S

title: 73 - As Long as There's Love
description: Prerequisite: Complete [72 - Private Lesson](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943917) and ask to play against a new opponent. Tips: - Choose an insect that has powerful Rock attacks, e.g [030 - Devil's Flower Mantis](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943693) with [001 - Cartwheel Kick](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943691) - for an easy victory. Reward: - 8,000 XP - [012 - Super Romero Special](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943929)

title: 74 - Time for a Raid!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [73 - As Long as There's Love](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943928) and ask to play against a new opponent. You'll need to have found at least 30 cards. Tips: - My winning cards were: - [030 - Devil's Flower Mantis](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943693) - [001 - Cartwheel Kick](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943691) - [009 - Omni Choke](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943660) - [017 - Body Slam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943661) Reward: - [010 - Japanese Giant Mantis](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943931)

title: 75 - The Professor's Past
description: Prerequisite: Complete [74 - Time for a Raid!](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943930) and speak to the Professor. Tips: - My winning cards were: - [027 - Asian Giant Hornet](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943700) - [002 - Face Masher](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943659) - [027 - Banana Split](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943702) - [018 - Tomoe Nage](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943696) Reward: - 15,000 XP - [008 - Last Resort](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943933)

title: 76 - The Professor's Past 2
description: Prerequisite: Complete [75 - The Professor's Past](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943932) and speak to Hime inside [Club SEGA, Theater Square](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942794) Tips: - My winning cards were: - [027 - Asian Giant Hornet](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943700) - [002 - Face Masher](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943659) - [027 - Banana Split](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943702) - [018 - Tomoe Nage](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943696) Reward: - 20,000 XP - [020 - Wasp King](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943935)

title: 77 - Enjoying It With Everyone
description: Prerequisite: Speak to the Professor after completing [76 - The Professor's Past 2](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943934) Tips: - You can only battle Masashi after collecting at least 40 cards. - My winning cards were: - [003 - Empress Cicada](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943703) - [001 - Cartwheel Kick](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943691) - [009 - Omni Choke](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943660) - [017 - Body Slam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943661) Reward: - 25,000 XP - [015 - Tie Breaker](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943937)

title: 45 - Of Luck and Debt
description: Prerequisite: Drink at [Shellac](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942773) 2-3 times. The substory will start when you enter to find a different person behind the bar. Tips: - The secret casino is beneath [Kyushu No. 1 Star](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942772). You'll learn the password via [01 - The Price of an F-cup](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943489) or [31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943657). - A Goddess of Children Amulet is the reward for completing [42 - The Cell Phone Plan](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944129), but it can also be purchased in the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - 50,000 Yen - 5,000 XP

title: 42 - The Cell Phone Plan
description: Prerequisite: Approach the men standing by the vending machines. Tips: - You'll need to manually open Locker C1. - The amulet you get as a reward can be used to complete [45 - Of Luck and Debt](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943924) Reward: - Goddess of Children Amulet - 5,000 XP

title: 48 - Memories of the Bubble
description: Prerequisite: Walk past a woman standing at the edge of the [Debolah](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942814) dance floor. Tips: - The fan and bodycon dress you need to buy are at [Don Quijote](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942786) - You'll need 59,800 Yen. Reward: - Double Feathered Fans - 15,000 XP

title: 52 - The Value of 2,000 Yen
description: Prerequisite: Approach the glasses-wearing man sitting at the bar in [Vincent](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942801). Tips: - Only one bill can be held at a time; bring them back to the collector to get a new one. - The bills can be found in these places: - [Yoshida Batting Center](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942766#L) - held by the man near the arcade cabinets. - [Club SEGA, Theater Square](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942794#L) - held by a man sitting near the counter. - Held by a man on the corner of the street north-east of [Kotobuki Drugs](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942785#L) - Held by the clerk of [Poppo, Tenkaichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942789#L) - Held by a man opposite [Kazama Family Office](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942806#L) Reward: - 20,000 Yen per bill - 15,000 XP

title: 13 - Pay It Forward
description: Prerequisite: Enter the park. Tips: - This substory is available in Chapter 4, but can only be completed in Chapter 6. - Sake can be purchased from [M Store](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942784) - The Worn-out Coat is given to a homeless man just south of [Beam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942787) - The glasses are given to a man outside of [Asia](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942792) - Super Strength Adhesive Tape is given to a man at the top-middle part of [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765). - Finally, the Silver Briefcase goes to a man in the alley near [Key I5](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943185). Reward: - Swiss Watch - 1,000 XP

title: 02 - My Baby's A Showgirl
description: Prerequisite: Receive a call from Yuya. May only be possible after completing [13 - Pay It Forward](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943503) Reward: - Free Pass for Asia - 20,000 XP

title: 58 - In Pursuit of Pleasure
description: Prerequisite: Approach the street corner. Tips: - You'll meet for food at [Kanrai](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942779). - You'll then go to [JeweL](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942799). - Next up is the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183) - be ready for a fairly tough fight! Reward: - Shinichi Shinohara added to roster of Coliseum fighters - 15,000 XP

title: 29 - The Heart of Vandalism
description: Prerequisite: Approach the old man standing opposite [Mach Bowl](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942803). Reward: - 50,000 Yen - 30,000 XP

title: 43 - Yakuza on the Run
description: Prerequisite: Speak to the man running around this area. Reward: - [Key J5](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944193) - 30,000 XP

title: 44 - Bad Boy in Blue
description: Prerequisite: Approach the cop standing by the alley. Reward: - 70,000 Yen - 35,000 XP

title: 59 - Komaki Style: Shot Stopper
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765). Reward: - Komaki Shot Stopper fighting move unlocked - 1,000 XP

title: 60 - Komaki Style: Swordsmanship
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [59 - Komaki Style: Shot Stopper](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944195) and equipping a wooden katana. Tips: - You can buy a wooden katana from [Ebisu Pawn](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942783). Reward: - Komaki Slash Attack fighting move unlocked - 2,000 XP

title: 61 - Komaki Style - Roundhouse Attack
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [60 - Komaki Style: Swordsmanship](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944196) and acquiring the Image of an Asura. Tips: - You can buy the Image of an Asura from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Roundhouse Attack fighting move unlocked - 3,000 XP

title: 62 - Komaki Style: Cat-Like Reflexes
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [61 - Komaki Style - Roundhouse Attack](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944197) and acquiring the Image of a Cat. Tips: - You can buy the Image of a Cat from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Cat-Like Reflexes fighting move unlocked - 4,000 XP

title: 63 - Komaki Style: Clear-Minded Mastery
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [62 - Komaki Style: Cat-Like Reflexes](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944198) and acquiring the Image of a Snake. Tips: - You can buy the Image of a Snake from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). - Majima must be around; if he's specifically waiting for you somewhere or in a pre-rank-up ambush, sort that out first. Reward: - Komaki Clear-Minded Mastery fighting move unlocked - 5,000 XP

title: 64 - Komaki Style: Evade and Strike
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [63 - Komaki Style: Clear-Minded Mastery](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944199) and acquiring the Image of a Kamaitachi. Tips: - You can buy the Image of a Kamaitachi from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Evade and Strike fighting move unlocked - 6,000 XP

title: 65 - Komaki Style: Dharma Tumbler
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [64 - Komaki Style: Evade and Strike](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944200) and acquiring the Image of Dharma. Tips: - You can buy the Image of Dharma from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Dharma Tumbler fighting move unlocked - 7,000 XP

title: 66 - Komaki Style: Fist Reversal
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [65 - Komaki Style: Dharma Tumbler](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944201) and acquiring the Image of Four Gods. Tips: - You can buy the Image of Four Gods from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Fist Reversal fighting move unlocked - 8,000 XP

title: 67 - Komaki Style: Knock Back
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [66 - Komaki Style: Fist Reversal](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944202) and acquiring the Image of an Elephant. Tips: - You can buy the Image of an Elephant from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Knock Back fighting move unlocked - 9,000 XP

title: 68 - Komaki Style: Tiger Drop
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [67 - Komaki Style: Knock Back](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944203) and acquiring the Image of a Tiger. Tips: - You can buy the Image of a Tiger from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Tiger Drop fighting move unlocked - 10,000 XP

title: 69 - Komaki Style: Parry
description: Prerequisite: Speak to Komaki in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [68 - Komaki Style: Tiger Drop](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944204) and acquiring the Image of a Dragon. Tips: - You can buy the Image of a Dragon from the [Coliseum](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944183). Reward: - Komaki Parry fighting move unlocked - 11,000 XP

title: 78 - Battle for the MesuKing Throne
description: Prerequisite: Speak to the Professor after completing [77 - Enjoying It With Everyone](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943936) and finding at least 50 MesuKing cards. Reward: - 30,000 XP - [002 - Hercules Beetle](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944212)

title: 05 - A Doctor's Duty
description: Prerequisite: Approach the boy. May only be possible after completing [13 - Pay It Forward](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=943503) Tips: - This substory can be started in Chapter 6, but is impossible to finish until Chapter 7. - After feeding him, bring Haruka to the boy at night. - The doctor you need is a few buildings west of [Akaushimaru, Tenkaichi Street](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942770). Reward: - 45,000 XP

title: 03 - Bet on a Champ
description: Prerequisite: Bring Haruka to [Bantam](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942780). Tips: - The password is "I came to take shelter from the rain". Reward: - 45,000 XP

title: 41 - The B-King's Misfortune
description: Prerequisite: Approach the group of men. Reward: - Brawler Amulet - 50,000 XP

title: 40 - The Medicine Goes Down
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man laying in the street after completing [41 - The B-King's Misfortune](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944208). Tips: - Confront the men wearing red. Reward: - 150,000 Yen - 50,000 XP

title: 39 - Kyoka and Takashi
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man standing outside of West Park after completing [41 - The B-King's Misfortune](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944208). Tips: - A sandwich can be purchased from [M Store](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942784). Any kind will do. Reward: - Gambler's Binding - 50,000 XP

title: 50 - Searching for the Present
description: Prerequisite: Bring Haruka to the park. Tips: - The reward you get is determined by the presents you deliver. Reward: - Mew Shoes (if you chose the AiAi plush, Golem Tiger, Shrink-Wrapped Book, or Crossword) - Staminan Royale (if you chose the Math Book or Car Compendium) - 3,000 XP

title: 51 - Bad Ass Dads
description: Prerequisite: Speak to the woman near the fountain in [West Park](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765). Tips: - The reward you get is determined by your final answer. Reward: - Italian Shoulder Bag (if your final answer is "Having less common sense than normal men.") - Wild Shirt (if your final answer is "Going to a tanning salon every day." or "...I have no clue!") - 50,000 XP

title: 49 - The Rumored Party
description: Prerequisite: Visit [Stardust](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942807) and speak to a host inside. Reward: - Tourmaline Bracelet - 50,000 XP

title: 37 - Gangbusters
description: Prerequisite: Pass by the men standing on the street corner. Reward: - 30,000 Yen - 50,000 XP

title: 09 - The Stalker
description: Prerequisite: Approach the woman standing by the street after completing [37 - Gangbusters](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944216) Reward: - 30,000 Yen - 50,000 XP

title: 06 - The Fake Mizuki's Truth
description: Prerequisite: Visit the Florist's office in [Purgatory](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after completing [05 - A Doctor's Duty](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=944206). Haruka cannot be with you. Reward: - 50,000 XP

title: 07 - Man on a Ledge
description: Prerequisite: Approach the crowd while Haruka is with you. Reward: - 60,000 XP

title: 04 - The Yakuza's Wife
description: Prerequisite: Visit the Florist's office in [Purgatory](https://mapgenie.io/yakuza-kiwami/maps/kamurocho?locationIds=942765) after receiving a call from him. Haruka cannot be with you. Reward: - 59,200 XP

title: 57 - Behind the Assassin
description: Prerequisite: Approach the man standing by the street. Haruka cannot be with you. Reward: - 35,000 XP

title: 46 - The Last Assassin
description: Prerequisite: Complete every other substory, purchase every ability, and reach Majima rank SSS. Tips: - Tiger Drop is your best friend. - Stock up on HP / Heat consumables - Bring plenty of weapons, e.g Zap Guns & Spicy Knives - Equip Gauntlets to block his knife in phase 2. Reward: - Amon Sunglasses - 89,300 XP
